calls.statement:
WITH params AS (SELECT 15 AS campaign_id),
campaign AS (
    SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date + 7 AS window_end
    FROM dim_campaign c JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
),
targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = e.campaign_id
),
holdout AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.member_id
    FROM campaign_holdout h
    JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = h.campaign_id
),
members AS (
    SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted
    UNION ALL
    SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
    GROUP BY 1
),
by_group AS (
    SELECT mb.member_group, COUNT(*) AS members, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales
    FROM members mb
    LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT member_group, members, ROUND(mean_net_sales, 2) AS mean_net_sales_per_member
FROM by_group
UNION ALL
SELECT 'uplift (targeted - holdout)', NULL,
       ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'targeted' THEN mean_net_sales END)
           - MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'holdout' THEN mean_net_sales END), 2)
FROM by_group
UNION ALL
SELECT 'check: members in both groups', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted JOIN holdout USING (member_id)), NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT exposure_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT e.member_key) keys, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) mids,
 MIN(contact_ts_utc) mn, MAX(contact_ts_utc) mx, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) deliv,
 SUM(CASE WHEN m.marketing_consent THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) noconsent,
 SUM(CASE WHEN m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) holdout_contacted,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15) hr, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15) hd
FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15

SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl,
 SUM(CASE WHEN member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) memb,
 MIN(etl_loaded_at) mn, MAX(etl_loaded_at) mx, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads,
 MAX(sale_date) maxd
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-20' AND DATE '2025-12-15'

SELECT w.status, COUNT(*) orders, SUM(CASE WHEN w.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) memb, MIN(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) mino, MAX(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) maxo,
 SUM(CASE WHEN dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nodisp
FROM fact_web_order w WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-20' AND DATE '2025-12-15' GROUP BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, w.status, COUNT(*) lines, SUM(f.net_amount) net, SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) memb_lines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN w.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_order
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-20' AND DATE '2025-12-15' AND (s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH elig AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE marketing_consent AND DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to AND join_date <= DATE '2025-11-24'),
t AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM elig) elig, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM elig WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM t) AND member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM h)) elig_unreached,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM elig)) t_not_elig,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM elig)) h_not_elig,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE member_key IS NOT NULL AND member_key NOT IN (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member)) orphan_sales,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE member_key NOT IN (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member)) orphan_exp

calls.statement:
WITH t AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
g AS (SELECT member_id,'targeted' grp FROM t UNION ALL SELECT member_id,'holdout' FROM h),
wd AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) d FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
s AS (SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) net, SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 LEFT JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE st.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND COALESCE(wd.d,f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT grp, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN s.net IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) buyers, AVG(COALESCE(net,0)) mean, MAX(net) mx, SUM(COALESCE(staff,0)) staff, SUM(CASE WHEN net<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negs,
 quantile_cont(net,0.99) p99
FROM g LEFT JOIN s USING (member_id) GROUP BY 1
